name: atrium-frontend-demo
description: Atrium web app - employee self-service portal. Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Tailwind v4, Reka UI, TanStack Query, MSW demo mode. Portfolio demo with fictional data.

paragraphs: An employee self-service portal where every request shows whose desk it is on: training, travel, company devices, onboarding and offboarding, and company news, in one calm Nuxt app.
Live demo · runs entirely in your browser, pick any persona to sign in · Backend repository (NestJS API)

Atrium is a clean-room re-engineering of an internal employee portal, built as a portfolio demo. All people, companies and data are fictional: the company is "Acme IT Services", and every address uses the reserved example.com domain. Every integration is local or mocked. In the live demo the whole API runs in your browser, and sign-in uses demo personas instead of a corporate identity provider.
features: The home page greets you and lists what needs you today, most urgent first. Each row can be handled where it stands: accept a laptop, grade a training, write learning goals. Approvers get the same items in the Inbox, a…

Requests are written in a focused stepper. The summary slip on the right previews the approval route from the server's own rules, so a choice like an automatic gearbox or foreign travel shows "Needs approval because..."…
The travel desk books from its queue: high-priority trips first, booking confirmation as a PDF, the booking PIN stored encrypted and shown to the traveller on demand.
